title: An order, across three diagrams
lede: Explore 48 classes with a moving focus window and three linked views of an order.

nodes.label: Order
nodes.detail: A shared order identity appears in three linked diagrams. Its 27 direct relationships are divided by subject; this is a reading aid, not an endorsement of a highly coupled domain model.

steps.title: Order anchors the purchase.
steps.body: Its nine direct neighbors move closer. Every relationship in this neighborhood remains visible.

steps.title: Travel to Product.
steps.body: The camera follows the class. Product’s direct neighbors gather around it; unrelated classes recede.

steps.title: A smaller neighborhood, at reading size.
steps.body: The focus window adapts to the local relationships instead of shrinking the whole model to fit.

steps.title: The same Order, another diagram.
steps.body: Order has 27 direct relationships overall. They are split into three linked diagrams, each below the limit of 20.

steps.title: Follow Warehouse into stock.
steps.body: Distance in the original map does not prevent a direct neighbor from joining the focused neighborhood.

steps.title: Follow a relationship to Shipment.
steps.body: Zoom out or drag at any moment. That pauses the tour and leaves the camera under your control.

steps.title: Order enters the settlement view.
steps.body: The shared class keeps its identity. A linked view changes the reading scope, never the underlying relationships.

steps.title: Payment has specializations.
steps.body: Hollow triangles still point to Payment. Repositioning preserves UML direction, ownership and relationship meaning.

assumptions: Illustrative commerce model; not extracted from a production schema.
Order has 27 relationships across three subject-based views. Each view has at most 20 relationships per class. This is a readability policy, not a UML rule or an architectural refactoring.
Members and cardinalities are deliberately minimal; inspector details preserve every supplied member.
Moving positions express reading focus, not object execution or changed relationships.
evidence: Evidence: synthetic teaching model. No application repository was supplied.
